design.condition_scope: simple linear count baseline vs V9 zero shift, broadening, polynomial background, Poisson-Gaussian readout
design.q_scope: single known CIF; interpolation in du,dv, not unseen-structure generalization
design.test_scope: exploratory follow-up; prior BaTiO3 test history exists, not blind confirmatory evidence
design.profile_metric: MSE on max-normalized log1p_100 profiles; deterministic expected profile, not a noise realization
design.eta_truth_policy: eta_true never enters the model, train/validation/test model input, B loss, or lambda selection; used only for generation/metadata and post-prediction nuisance mismatch diagnostics
design.backbone: same ML4PXRD ResNet-18-GN trunk; A has 2 q outputs and B has 2 q plus 3 nuisance outputs
design.parameter_count_note: B has a 3-output wider final linear head (771 additional parameters); no nuisance truth supervision
design.validation_rule: for each condition select lambda with lowest mean best-epoch validation normalized-q MAE across the three paired seeds; ties choose smaller lambda; test is evaluated once after selection

simple.selection_rule: lowest mean best-epoch validation normalized-q MAE over the three paired seeds; exact ties choose smaller lambda

v9.selection_rule: lowest mean best-epoch validation normalized-q MAE over the three paired seeds; exact ties choose smaller lambda
